_readme: How each piece of platform UI the edit draws LOOKS — a comment bubble, a post, a text thread, a stitch or duet frame, a search bar, a like or view counter, a review card. A platform_ui layer names a `kind` and may name a `style`; with no style it gets the kind's default row. Every style is drawn by the edit in plain HTML/CSS (no screenshots, no platform logos, no real app artwork), so it is a lookalike of the pattern, never a copy of a brand. Fonts are ids from looks/fonts.json; `zone` is an id from looks/placement.json. `registry` names a HyperFrames block that does the same thing, for later — nothing is installed. Only the owner signs a row approved.

styles.name: Reply sticker, white
styles.what: The white rounded sticker a creator pins when they answer a comment: a small 'Reply to @handle's comment' line over the comment in bold.
styles.when_to_use: The swipe opens by answering a comment. The default.

styles.name: Reply sticker, dark
styles.what: The same reply sticker in dark mode — near-black card, white words.
styles.when_to_use: Over bright footage where the white sticker would glare.

styles.name: Photo-app comment
styles.what: A single comment row: round avatar, bold handle, the comment beside it, a small heart at the right.
styles.when_to_use: The swipe quotes a comment from a photo feed.

styles.name: Video-site comment, dark
styles.what: A dark comment row: avatar, @handle and '2 days ago' in grey, the comment, a thumbs-up count under it.
styles.when_to_use: The swipe quotes a long-form video comment.

styles.name: Short post card
styles.what: A white post card: avatar, display name and @handle, the post in plain text, a row of reply / repost / like counts.
styles.when_to_use: The swipe quotes a post or a hot take.

styles.name: Text thread, blue
styles.what: A text thread: grey bubbles on the left (them), blue bubbles on the right (us), newest last. Each line of `text` is a bubble, alternating.
styles.when_to_use: A friend-to-friend exchange; 'my sister texted me this'.

styles.name: Chat thread, green
styles.what: A chat thread: white bubbles (them) and pale green bubbles (us), each with a small time stamp.
styles.when_to_use: A group-chat or family-chat moment; markets where that app is the default.

styles.name: DM, dark
styles.what: A generic dark-mode direct message: dark grey (them), violet (us). Belongs to no one app.
styles.when_to_use: A DM from a customer when the swipe does not show which app.

styles.name: Stitch frame
styles.what: A small dark pill top-left: 'Stitched with @handle'.
styles.when_to_use: The piece opens on someone else's clip and answers it.

styles.name: Duet frame
styles.what: A small dark pill top-left: 'Duet with @handle'.

styles.name: Search bar, light
styles.what: A white rounded search bar; the query types itself in one letter at a time.
styles.when_to_use: 'I searched why my skin…' — the moment a problem is typed.

styles.name: Search bar, dark
styles.what: The same search bar in dark mode.

styles.name: Like counter
styles.what: A big red heart with the count under it, white with a soft shadow.
styles.when_to_use: Social proof: '48.2K people liked this'. Sits on the LEFT — the real like button is on the right.

styles.name: View counter
styles.what: A play-triangle and a view count, like the count under a video thumbnail.

styles.name: Review card, five stars
styles.what: A white review card: five gold stars, a name with 'Verified buyer', the review in quotes.
styles.when_to_use: A single customer review over live footage (a full-screen review plate is a `screen` scene instead).

styles.name: Review card, dark
styles.what: The same review card, dark, stars gold.
styles.when_to_use: Over bright footage, or a premium read.
